description_en: Obtains the metadata for a component asset, which defines the fields that constitute the asset
description_zh: 用于获取组件的资产元信息，即资产信息是由哪些字段组成的
name: DescribeComponentAssetForm

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

ComponentAssetForm.description_en:
The configuration metadata for the component asset. The value is a string in the JSON array format. The array contains the following fields:

name: The name of the parameter.

defaultValue: The default value of the parameter.

description: The description of the parameter.

required: Specifies whether the parameter is required. A value of true means it is required. A value of false means it is optional
ComponentAssetForm.description_zh:
组件资产的配置元信息，为JSONArray格式，包含字段：

name：参数的名称
defaultValue：参数的默认值
description：参数描述信息
required：参数是否必填，true表示必填，false表示非必填
